issues.description: getConfig now memoizes values in the module-level `cache` Map, but updateConfig writes the new value to the DB without invalidating or updating that cache (no cache.delete(key) / cache.set(key, value)). After any update, getConfig keeps returning the stale cached value for the life of the process. updateConfig is itself modified in this diff (new `actor` param and log), so the invalidation belongs here. The added caching and the write path are both in the diff; the bug is that they aren't wired together.
